_comment: Reviewed per-entry decisions. Shape: { "<package>": { "<target>": { "field": "dependency" | "peer", "why": "<what reading the code showed>" } } }. A `dependency` promotion is added only after someone reads the published package and confirms the target is a library it genuinely needs its own copy of. A `peer` entry records a candidate that was reviewed and rejected, so nobody re-litigates it.
